text.en:
Section 2 of Executive Order No. 12 is hereby further amended to
include the Deputy Executive Secretary for Legal Affairs (DESLA) of the Office of the
President as ex-officio Commissioner.

All Executive Orders, rules, regulations and other issuances or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby
repealed, amended or otherwise modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately after it has been
published in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, Philippines this 30th day of October, 2009
there Mr. King
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
PGA Hologram * 51446 Executive Secretary
